title: Patch: Signature only on Full art + Animated, with its own art and motion; Full art offered on a varied set of cards
thread:
**Issue #2949 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2949: Patch: Signature only on Full art + Animated, with its own art and motion; Full art offered on a varied set of cards
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

## What it does

The owner's answers (2026-11-03) to #2725's open questions 2 and 3 change Part 1's model, which shipped in https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/2904 (rulings R2725000 to R2725004). This issue makes those changes before the ten new versions are built (#2940, #2942, #2943, #2944), so they build on the new rule.

### 1. Signature goes only on Full art + Animated, and has a look of its own

- **Owned separately.** Signature (`augment-signature`) stays its own Mythic augment, owned card by card. It does **not** include Full art or Animated: each of the three is owned and pulled on its own.
- **Worn only with both.** A card can switch Signature on only while it wears the **Full art version** and the **Animated augment**, each owned and offered on that card. Signature never goes on:
  - the normal face (undo R2725003's signature over the normal face's art window);
  - any other version, Alt full art (#2940) included.
- **Its own art and motion.** With Signature on, the face shows the **Signature look**: a full art and an animation of its own, unique to Signature, plus the signature. The look is distinct from the card's Full art picture, its Animated motion and every other version, Alt full art included. Like every look, it is a pure function of the card's id, name, tags and type, base and Radiant faces both. R2725004's Radiant rules hold: no gold, and every Radiant mark kept.
- **Server.**
  - A pick naming `augment-signature` without the Full art version and `augment-animated` in the same pick is refused with a 400, and nothing is written.
  - `freeze_loadout` and `keepable` drop Signature where either of the other two is missing, not owned or not offered.
  - Signature's `offer` is the cards offered both Full art and Animated, or a subset of them.
- **Client.**
  - `CardLook.signed` holds only alongside Full art + Animated.
  - The Collection offers the Signature toggle only while Full art and Animated are on, and turning either off turns Signature off.
- **Retired full arts (R2725002).** A retired Mythic still counts as owning all three on its card, so its pick now shows the Signature look. Nobody loses anything they own.

### 2. Animated: no change

The owner confirmed it: Animated stays an Epic, offered on (almost) all 243 cards, as R2725001 has it now.

### 3. Offers vary across cards

The owner wants the versions spread so that cards differ, not the same set of cards for every look.

- **Full art's `offer`** narrows from all 243 cards to a varied subset, recorded as data, as curated clauses or a seeded pick. It keeps a floor in every shipped set. The 21 hand-picked cards, whose retired full arts imply Full art, stay offered, so no pick that can be worn today stops working.
- **Signature** follows from its rule above.
- **The ten new versions** follow the same principle in their own issues.

The ruling (in this issue's own block) amends R2725000, R2725001, R2725002 and R2725003, and SPEC §14.2 changes with it. It changes how cards look, so it takes a `--visual` pending fragment.

## Acceptance

- A pick with Signature but without the Full art version and Animated, each owned and offered, is a 400 and writes nothing. A frozen loadout never carries Signature without both, and the other seat sees the same.
- The Signature look draws, base and Radiant, on every card Signature is offered on. A test holds it different from that card's Full art, from its Animated look and from the normal face.
- No face shows a signature without Full art + Animated, the normal face included. The Collection's toggle follows the rule.
- Full art's offer is a varied subset that holds its per-set floor (a config constant), with the 21 hand-picked cards in it. A test holds Signature's offer inside Full art's and Animated's.
- An account whose retired full art implied Signature still owns all three and sees the Signature look. No account gains or loses a cosmetic.
- The palette test (R2725004's `RADIANT_GOLD_CLEARANCE`) covers the Signature look's colours.
- A component (pixel) spec shows the Signature look on one Unit and one Spell, base and Radiant.
- The rulings pass `cargo jackioh spec check`, and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` passes.

**Order:** after #2725 (merged) and before #2940.
```
